assertions.text: exception where individually represented by counsel
applies to an employee who primarily works in California
assertions.note: sources state the test is an employee who primarily works AND RESIDES in California. The clause states only 'works', which overstates the section's reach — an employee working in California but residing elsewhere may fall outside it.

gaps: The prohibition attaches to requiring the provision as a condition of employment. The clause omits that qualifier and reads as though any such provision is voidable however it arose.
Injunctive relief is available alongside fees. The clause mentions only fees.
